libXaw 1.0.16 - X Athena Widgets

Source: https://www.x.org/releases/individual/lib/libXaw-1.0.16.tar.xz
Tarball: references/_tarballs/libXaw-1.0.16.tar.xz
Extracted to: references/libXaw-1.0.16/ (read-only reference copy)
Copied into third-party/: src/, include/, COPYING (unmodified).

License: MIT/X11 (see COPYING).

Build: driven by third-party/libXaw/CMakeLists.txt, not the upstream
autotools. Links against emx11 (our Xlib replacement) and Xt (our
libXt build in third-party/libXt/).

Upgrade procedure: replace references/_tarballs/libXaw-*.tar.xz with a
newer upstream release, re-extract into references/, diff against
third-party/libXaw/ to pick up any patches we have applied locally,
then re-copy src/ and include/.
